note: 30 questions over the five datasets in datasets.md. Answers are computed on the clean base (file with exact duplicate rows removed). `split` is a proposal: 10 development, 20 held-out, 2 + 4 per dataset; the held-out set is frozen later in heldout.json. Numbers must match within `tolerance` (absolute); text answers match ignoring case and surrounding spaces.
